name: mybrandos
description: mybrandOS — Gateway to a person's Digital Life

scripts.build: npm run build -w @mybrandos/shared && npm run build -w @mybrandos/integrations && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @mybrandos/api && npm run build -w @mybrandos/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @mybrandos/shared && npm run build -w @mybrandos/integrations && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @mybrandos/api
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build -w @mybrandos/shared && npm run build -w @mybrandos/integrations && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate:deploy && npm run db:seed
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @mybrandos/shared && npm run build -w @mybrandos/integrations && npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck -w @mybrandos/api && npm run typecheck -w @mybrandos/web
